laws.rule: Zug's rest-day and shop-hours Act (Ruhetags- und Ladenöffnungsgesetz, §§ 1, 2, 4 and 5): public rest days are Sundays and New Year's Day, Good Friday, Ascension, Corpus Christi, 1 August, Assumption, All Saints, Immaculate Conception and Christmas Day. On public rest days, all activities that disturb the quiet appropriate to the Sunday or holiday are banned. Retail shops may open Monday to Friday from 06:00 until 19:00 at the latest, and on Saturdays until 17:00 at the latest. The communal council may allow one late-night opening a week until 21:30, except on Saturdays and on the eves of New Year's Day, Good Friday, Ascension, 1 August and Christmas Day. Shops stay closed on public rest days, though the council may allow a general opening on at most two public rest days (not New Year's Day, Good Friday, Easter, Pentecost, the Federal Day of Prayer or Christmas) from 10:00 until 17:00 at the latest.
laws.heading: Ruhetags- und Ladenöffnungsgesetz, BGS 942.31, §§ 1, 2, 4 and 5; current version in force from 22 August 2025, read 11 November 2026

laws.rule: The cantonal contraventions Act (Übertretungsstrafgesetz, §§ 9, 13 and 18) and its fixed-penalty catalogue (annex to § 15, in force from 1 January 2025): causing unusual noise beyond what is usually tolerated at the place, or disturbing the usual night quiet by excessive noise, is a fine, as is begging that disturbs public order. The standard fixed penalties in the catalogue are CHF 100 (about A$173) for those noise offences and for begging. A cantonal fixed penalty may not exceed CHF 600 (about A$1,036).
